# VERIFIERS

**Generated by `node tools/check-verifiers.mjs --update-md`. Do not hand-edit.**

§5.12. Every command cited anywhere as evidence: what it claims to prove, the file
that implements it, and the defect that must make it fail.

This file exists because `BENCHMARKS.md` has been SHA-locked since iteration 6 and
the lock covered the thresholds only. Three separate times a check was cited as
evidence while not running - `maybe()` skipped its assertions, `assertPaise` had
never executed, and typecheck, lint and the money rule did not exist at all. The lock
now covers the instruments as well as the numbers.

Prove them with `node tools/check-verifiers.mjs --prove`, which plants each defect,
requires the command to fail, restores the file and verifies the restore.

## The inventory

| id | command | implemented by | claims | proven to fail by |
|----|---------|----------------|--------|-------------------|
| `governance` | `npm run check:governance` | `tools/check-governance.mjs` | No forbidden status token; every AD carries a reversal trigger; no stubs in shipped paths; one money-formatting path; verbatim injections unedited. | plants a defect in `REVIEW.md` |
| `benchmarks-lock` | `npm run check:benchmarks` | `tools/check-benchmarks-lock.mjs` | BENCHMARKS.md matches its committed SHA-256, so no threshold has been edited. | plants a defect in `BENCHMARKS.md` |
| `prose` | `npm run check:prose` | `tools/check-prose.mjs` | No sentence asserts both a resolved and an unresolved status; no dangling AD/B/G/H id. | plants a defect in `REVIEW.md` |
| `sms` | `npm run check:sms` | `tools/check-sms-templates.mjs` | SMS-TEMPLATES.md and the code registry agree; every sent templateId is registered; every duration stated in copy matches OTP_TTL_SECONDS. | plants a defect in `apps/api/src/rate-limit/limits.ts` |
| `sms-segments` | `npm run check:sms:segments` | `tools/check-sms-segments.mjs` | Every template fits ONE SMS segment under its real encoding (DC-001). | plants a defect in `apps/api/src/sms/templates.ts` |
| `tooling` | `npm run check:tooling` | `tools/check-tooling.mjs` | No cross-language source surgery; no known platform traps; no npm script naming a file that does not exist. | plants a defect in `package.json` |
| `generated` | `npm run check:generated` | `tools/check-generated.mjs` | Every generated artifact still matches what its authoring script produces. | plants a defect in `packages/formula-engine/vectors.json` |
| `font` | `npm run check:font` | `tools/check-font-coverage.mjs` | Every character in every Odia string has a NON-ZERO glyph in all three bundled weights; ory2 GSUB present; digits reachable as tabular; files match their hashes. | plants a defect in `apps/api/src/sms/templates.ts` |
| `money-lint` | `npm run check:money` | `tools/check-money-lint.mjs` | ADR-003 all four clauses: no money arithmetic outside the audited helpers, no float coercion of money, no decimal literals in the engine, formatting only at the render boundary. | plants a defect in `packages/formula-engine/src/operational.ts` |
| `typecheck` | `npm run typecheck` | `tsconfig.json` | Every .ts file under packages, apps and tools typechecks under strict mode. | plants a defect in `packages/formula-engine/src/money.ts` |
| `vectors-node` | `npm run test:vectors:node` | `tools/run-vectors.mjs` | Every golden vector produces its expected values under Node. | plants a defect in `packages/formula-engine/src/primary.ts` |
| `vectors-divergence` | `npm run test:vectors:diff` | `tools/diff-vectors.mjs` | Node and Hermes agree on every value of every vector (B2). | G5, by injecting a runtime-specific divergence. A source edit cannot fake it: the mutation has to behave DIFFERENTLY on each engine, so it is not plantable from one file. |
| `unit` | `npx vitest run` | `packages/formula-engine/test/vectors.spec.ts` | All specs pass, including the 63 golden vectors, now executed INSIDE the runner so coverage can see them. | plants a defect in `packages/schema/src/spec.ts` |
| `coverage` | `npm run coverage` | `package.json` | Measures formula-engine statement, branch and function coverage (B3). | Proven by CORRECTING it. The first run reported 57.73% branch while the 63 vectors ran in a separate process the instrument could not see; putting them under the runner moved the same unchanged engine to 85.71%. An instrument whose reading moves 28 points when you fix the instrument has demonstrated that it measures something. |
| `audit` | `npm audit --audit-level=high` | `package-lock.json` | No high or critical advisory in the dependency tree (B33). | External fact; not plantable without installing a known-vulnerable package. |
| `detection-rate` | `node tools/detection-rate.mjs` | `tools/detection-rate.mjs` | §5.9 - for each critical invariant, what FRACTION of the suite notices when it is violated. | It is itself a defect-planting harness, and it verifies its own restore each run. |
